labels.lesson.title: Bring Contributions Together into a Shared Proposal
labels.section.title: Map the Contributions before Combining Them
labels.prompt.exact: A community book club wants a 30-minute taster activity for new readers. Help them try discussing a short text and find out how the weekly club works. Your group should recommend one coherent activity and explain how it serves both aims. Use the main room, the supplied one-page text and club information sheet, and existing paper and pens; do not buy anything. Leave at least five minutes within the session for visitors' questions.
labels.goal.club: Learn how the weekly club works
labels.source.maya: Pairs could compare one line from the short text before we share anything with the whole group.
labels.source.noah: A short demonstration could show newcomers what it means to give an interpretation and a reason.
labels.link.example: Example may help introduce the pair task
labels.source.participant: I suggest keeping time for questions about the club, using the information sheet for anything it actually answers.
labels.format.optional: Use a format that helps this task
